# RSS-BOOK
Last-checked: 2026-09-22

> RSS-BOOK is a privacy-first Manifest V3 browser extension for Chrome, Edge,
> Brave and Vivaldi. It turns RSS and Atom feed entries into browser bookmarks
> instead of storing them in a cloud account.

## Canonical links

- GitHub: https://github.com/file-bricks/RSS-BOOK
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/rss-book/aednfjhookicnhcjhjifbaepglinbdli
- Releases: https://github.com/file-bricks/RSS-BOOK/releases
- Privacy policy: https://github.com/file-bricks/RSS-BOOK/blob/main/PRIVACY_POLICY.md
- Ecosystem: https://github.com/file-bricks
- Umbrella: https://github.com/open-bricks

## What it does

- Saves RSS and Atom feed entries as browser bookmarks.
- Uses local browser storage for configuration and cache metadata.
- Supports OPML import/export, feed discovery, notifications and dark mode.
- Avoids accounts, telemetry, analytics and third-party proxy services.
- Runs as a dependency-free Chromium Manifest V3 extension.
- Publishes a Chrome Web Store listing and a GitHub release ZIP for sideloading.
- Exports bookmark feeds as Windows/OneDrive `.url` shortcut files.

## Developer commands

```bash
npm test
npm run package
npm run edge-preflight
```

## Target Personas

- `[PERSONA-01]` Privacy-Conscious News & Tech Readers (no-account RSS without cloud profiling)
- `[PERSONA-02]` Chromium Multi-Device Power Users (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi bookmark sync across machines)
- `[PERSONA-03]` Extension & Local-First Software Engineers (clean Manifest V3, alarms, storage, 0 runtime dependencies)
- `[PERSONA-04]` Information Curators & Research Archivists (OPML 2.0 and Windows/OneDrive `.url` folder exports)

## Important files

- `manifest.json` - Chromium Manifest V3 extension metadata.
- `sw.js` - service worker for scheduled feed updates.
- `lib/rss.js` - RSS/Atom parser.
- `lib/bookmarks.js` - bookmark folder and item management.
- `lib/opml.js` - OPML import/export.
- `lib/export.js` - Windows `.url` shortcut export.
- `ui/popup.html` / `ui/options.html` - extension interface.
- `_locales/` (`en`, `de`, `es`) - UI strings with automated key-parity and placeholder validation.
- `tests/` - Node built-in test suite (85 automated tests, 100% green).

## Disambiguation

RSS-BOOK is not an RSS feed generator for books, an icon pack, a GitBook plugin,
or a cloud RSS reader. It is the file-bricks browser extension that stores RSS
and Atom entries as browser bookmarks.
